mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_name, stock_code, quiz_date, image, correct_answer, note, created_at FROM quiz_questions ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_questions (id, stock_name, stock_code, quiz_date, image, correct_answer, note, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{stockName}, #{stockCode}, #{quizDate}, #{image}, #{correctAnswer}, #{note}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_name, stock_code, quiz_date, image, correct_answer, note, created_at FROM quiz_questions WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_answers (id, question_id, user_answer, ai_evaluation, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{questionId}, #{userAnswer}, #{aiEvaluation}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, question_id, user_answer, ai_evaluation, created_at FROM quiz_answers WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
